title: JK Cement launches South Indian rail connection for new Udaipur cement plant
summary: JK Cement launches South Indian rail connection for new Udaipur cement plant
body_markdown: **India:** JK Cement and logistics partner Container Corporation of India (CONCOR) have launched a long-haul, containerised cement rail service between the Khemli cement terminal in Rajasthan’s Udaipur district and Inland Container Depot Whitefield (ICDW) in Bengaluru, Karnataka. Maritime Gateway News has reported that the service will connect JK Cement’s new Udaipur plant to the South India market. This will help the producer to further transfer its logistics from road to rail.
